instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: After hearing this, you may want to ask, does a pay raise change your personality too? But wait, before you decide that is true, the team studied data that tracked changes over time. This cannot prove that income changed personality or that personality increased income. Something else may have affected both. Coming first and being the cause are two different things. In a drama, the person we see first at the scene is not always the criminal. The order of events can give us a clue, but it cannot solve the case by itself. So when you look back at your income or the way you work, you don't have to end with, that's just my personality. Ask instead, what has changed in me lately? Then look more closely. Instead of judging other people, look for changes in yourself. With income and personality, changing who you compare yourself with can show a very different picture.
